en.title: Resident Evil Requiem Dominates Golden Joysticks, Clinches Ultimate Game of the Year
en.summary: Capcom's latest survival horror masterpiece, Resident Evil Requiem, has stormed the Golden Joystick Awards 2026, taking home the coveted Ultimate Game of the Year award. The win solidifies Requiem's status as a major contender in the gaming landscape.
en.body:
The gaming world is still buzzing from the **Golden Joystick Awards 2026**, where **Capcom**’s latest survival horror sensation, **Resident Evil Requiem**, was crowned **Ultimate Game of the Year**. This prestigious award, decided by a massive public vote, saw **Requiem** secure a commanding 17% of the votes. The competition was fierce, with **Phantom Blade Zero** and **Crimson Desert** trailing closely behind in second and third place, respectively, showcasing the incredible quality of games released this year.

**Resident Evil Requiem**’s triumph extends beyond the top prize. The critically acclaimed title also scooped **Console Game of the Year**, a testament to its exceptional performance on dedicated gaming hardware. Furthermore, **Angela Sant'Albano** earned the **Best Lead Performer** award for her captivating portrayal of **Grace Ashcroft**, adding another significant accolade to the game’s impressive haul. The **Best Game Trailer** award further underscores the comprehensive excellence of **Requiem**’s presentation, from gameplay to marketing.

## A Resounding Victory for Survival Horror

The win for **Resident Evil Requiem** at the **Golden Joystick Awards** is more than just a personal triumph for the game; it's a powerful statement about the genre's enduring popularity and its capacity to captivate players worldwide. The **Resident Evil** series has a storied history, constantly reinventing itself while staying true to its survival horror roots. **Requiem** appears to have struck that perfect balance, offering a compelling narrative, terrifying scares, and engaging gameplay that has clearly resonated with fans. The close race for Game of the Year, with **Phantom Blade Zero** and **Crimson Desert** also receiving substantial support, indicates a healthy and diverse gaming landscape, but ultimately, **Requiem**'s polished execution and immersive world captured the hearts of the voting public.

## Fan Frenzy and What's Next

Online communities and social media platforms have been alight with praise for **Resident Evil Requiem** since the announcement. Fans are celebrating the win, sharing their favorite moments from the game and debating the nuances of **Grace Ashcroft**'s performance. The success of **Requiem** also positions **Capcom** strongly, having been recognized as **Studio of the Year** for their consistent output of high-quality titles. With **Requiem** now firmly established as a game of the year, attention is already turning towards what **Capcom** will deliver next. While details on future **Resident Evil** projects remain under wraps, the studio's current trajectory suggests that fans have much to look forward to.

## Looking Ahead

The eligibility window for the **Golden Joystick Awards 2026** closed on November 11, meaning **Resident Evil Requiem**’s wins are officially cemented for this year’s ceremony. As players continue to explore the terrifying world of **Requiem**, the industry watches with keen interest to see how **Capcom** will build upon this monumental success in their upcoming projects.
